sentimento.text1: In the Polymarket winner contract, Flávio Bolsonaro stands at 55.55% (USD 11.83M cumulative volume) and Lula at 43.50% (USD 12.21M cumulative volume), reading confirmed on 25/Sep, 17:08 BRT. These are exactly the same prices as in the previous confirmed reading, on 24/Sep at 22:45 BRT, and the gap stays at 12.05pp, after three days running of narrowing: 22.40pp on 21/Sep, 19.05pp on 22/Sep, 18.35pp on 23/Sep and 12.05pp on 24/Sep.
sentimento.text2: ⚖️ AN UNCHANGED PRICE DOES NOT MEAN A STILL BOOK. In the 8 points recorded in the backup between the two confirmed readings, from 00:00 to 14:30 BRT on 25/Sep, Flávio Bolsonaro's price ranged from 54.30% to 56.30% and returned to the same 55.55%, while Lula's stayed at 43.50% in all of them. The pair sum stood at 99.05 in both readings, so the normalized move is also zero. The presidential book received USD 0.19M of new money and totals USD 155.09M cumulative across 19 contracts. ⚠️ Neither of them is at an extreme: Flávio Bolsonaro's price is 6.15pp from the top of the series, 61.70% on 21/Sep, and Lula's is 9.00pp from his floor, 34.50% on 25/Apr.
sentimento.text3: 🗳️ NO NEW NATIONAL POLL WAS RELEASED ON 25/Sep, and the six from 24/Sep are still the most recent, without agreeing on who leads either round: in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) they run from Lula 40% to 33% at Alfa/TMC to Flávio Bolsonaro 40.4% to 38.4% at Futura, and in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) from Lula 47% to 45% at Datafolha to Flávio Bolsonaro 49.4% to 43.7% at Futura. What came out on 25/Sep were breakdowns of the Datafolha poll of 24/Sep, such as the 38% tie in the interior of the country, and state polls. 📅 The [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) registry sets the next national releases for Veritá, n=40,500, on 26/Sep, Gerp on 27/Sep, [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) and Nexus on 28/Sep, AtlasIntel, Palver, Vox Brasil and JOTA on 29/Sep, and 100 Cidades, Indexa and Ideia on 30/Sep. A registered release is a commitment by the pollster, not a published number.
sentimento.direita: Flávio Bolsonaro at 55.55% in the winner contract (USD 11.83M cumulative volume), with no move in the reading confirmed on 25/Sep, 17:08 BRT, neither raw nor normalized, and in the points recorded between the two confirmed readings his price ranged from 54.30% to 56.30%. He is 6.15pp from the top of the series, 61.70% on 21/Sep, and 33.55pp from the floor, 22.00% on 03/Jul. In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) runner-up contract he gives up 1.00pp raw and 0.89pp normalized, to 74.50% (USD 1.16M), with the sum of that pair going from 100.00 to 99.85. 📰 On the campaign trail, he called the government's measure against betting sites (bets) hypocritical and electioneering and said Lula is the "father of the tigrinho", as Folha de S.Paulo, O Globo and Poder360 report, and Estadão reports that he said he tried to speak with Daniel Vorcaro in the four days before the banker's arrest to discuss the film Dark Horse.
sentimento.esquerda: Lula at 43.50% in the winner contract (USD 12.21M cumulative volume), with no move in the reading confirmed on 25/Sep, 17:08 BRT, and his price stayed at 43.50% in every point recorded between the two confirmed readings. ⚠️ It is not an extreme: he is 24.00pp from the top of the series, 67.50% on 16/Aug, and 9.00pp from the floor, 34.50% on 25/Apr. In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) runner-up contract he rises 0.85pp raw and 0.89pp normalized, to 25.35% (USD 0.99M). 📰 On the campaign trail, he defended ending betting sites at a campaign rally and said football clubs will have to find money some other way, as Folha de S.Paulo, G1 and VEJA report, and at the same rally he associated the Bolsonaros with Daniel Vorcaro, according to Folha.
sentimento.terceiraVia: 🥉 IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) THIRD PLACE CONTRACT THE THREE LEADING NAMES RISE RAW, AND IT IS ALMOST ALL OVERROUND: Renan Santos goes to 45.50% (USD 0.41M cumulative volume), up 1.50pp, Augusto Cury to 41.05% (USD 0.28M), up 1.10pp, and Ronaldo Caiado to 14.50% (USD 0.17M), up 0.50pp. But the sum of the whole book went from 99.25 to 102.25, and normalized by it Renan Santos gains 0.17pp, Augusto Cury gives up 0.11pp and Ronaldo Caiado gains 0.08pp. Raw, the distance between the top two goes from 4.05pp to 4.45pp, in the series 19.95pp, 5.25pp, 3.05pp, 4.15pp, 4.05pp and now 4.45pp. Romeu Zema stays at 0.35%. 📰 And according to Estadão of 25/Sep, The Economist called Renan Santos a combative libertarian and named him the most suitable candidate.
sentimento.polymarket: Prices from the reading confirmed on 25/Sep, 17:08 BRT (25/Sep, 20:08 UTC), with the presidential book totalling USD 155.09M cumulative across 19 contracts. AFOS only publishes a price that two independent readings, eight minutes apart, confirm within 0.20pp, contract by contract. Volume is cumulative since each contract opened. ⚖️ Alongside the raw move goes the one normalized by the pair sum, or by the whole book when it has more than two relevant names, because the sum of the prices moves on its own. 🗳️ The poll side of the divergence chart uses ONE national poll, not the average: the rule is the most recent one with ties broken by the largest sample, which still gives Palver of 24/Sep, n=5,000, and the choice is declared in the chart itself.

inss.text1: ⚖️ ON 25/Sep EDSON FACHIN GAVE THE PROSECUTOR GENERAL'S OFFICE (PGR) FIVE DAYS TO WEIGH IN ON THE PENDING REQUESTS IN THE [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) AND MASTER CASE INVESTIGATIONS, among them requests to review or revoke detentions, as Gazeta do Povo, G1 and Estadão report. The decision settles none of the requests: after the opinion, the case files go back to him. The investigations have been with the presidency of the Supreme Court since 12/Sep.
inss.text2: ⚠️ WHAT SITS OUTSIDE THE GOVERNMENT'S COUNT HAS A FIGURE, AND IT IS STILL THE ONE FROM 03/Sep. Requests delayed beyond 45 days totalled 261 thousand in August, against 1.88 million requests in the full queue. The page keeps the previous figure because there was no new measurement, and it does not estimate.
inss.text3: The definition the government uses, given by the Social Security minister and quoted by Metrópoles on 03/Sep, is that clearing the queue means analysing faster than the legal deadline of 45 days, not having no request under analysis. The two sentences describe different realities, and the distinction belongs to the vocabulary rather than to the measurement.
inss.text4: 📌 ALSO ON 25/Sep, FOLHA DE S.PAULO REPORTS THAT THE DEFENCE OF A FORMER [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) PRESIDENT TURNED TO THE PRESIDENCY OF THE SUPREME COURT against a detention that has lasted more than 300 days; the act has a single source and is included here with attribution. ⚖️ The personal link between the INSS and the Master case recorded on 24/Sep remains the same: the plane Flávio Bolsonaro travelled on in 2025, linked to Daniel Vorcaro and to a lawyer under investigation in the INSS fraud case, and which the senator says belongs to a lawyer friend.
inss.impactoLula: The approval benchmark of this panel is still the [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) poll of 21/Sep, registration BR-06004/2026, with 44% approval against 50% disapproval, and on 25/Sep there was no new wave from the pollster. ⚠️ APPROVAL WAS MEASURED ON 24/Sep BY DATAFOLHA, ALFA/TMC, FUTURA, PALVER AND PODERDATA, and the spread between them is wider in approval than in disapproval: Datafolha with 47% against 50%, Alfa/TMC with 46% against 50%, Futura/100% Cidades with 44.2% against 53.3%, Palver with 44% against 55% and PoderData/Aya with 41% against 50% on the question about Lula's performance. That is 6 points of distance in approval and 5 in disapproval. Adding Datafolha of 17/Sep, Quaest of 21/Sep and AtlasIntel of 23/Sep, approval measured in eight readings from seven pollsters, between 17 and 24/Sep, runs from 41% to 48%.
inss.impactoGestao: Within [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) itself the approval and disapproval series is this: 48% against 47% on 05/Aug, 46% against 48% on 14/Aug, 45% against 48% on 02/Sep, 43% against 50% on 07/Sep, 43% against 50% on 14/Sep and 44% against 50% on 21/Sep. The 5 point fall stopped and gave 1 back, within the margin. ⭐ And the ASSESSMENT benchmark moved the opposite way in the SAME Quaest wave: the negative rose from 38% to 42%, the positive from 32% to 33% and the fair rating fell from 27% to 23%. These are two different questions and they do not add up. 📌 Datafolha of 24/Sep measures the assessment at 40% negative and 34% positive, and Alfa of the same day adds a third question, which also does not add up with the other two: 55% say Lula does not deserve to be re-elected against 43% who back a new term.
inss.conclusao: What this round measures on the subject is procedural, not about the merits: on 25/Sep Edson Fachin opened a five day window for the Prosecutor General's Office to give its opinion on the pending requests in the [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) and Master case investigations, without deciding any of them. In the polls there was no new national poll on 25/Sep, and in the five from 24/Sep that measured approval it runs from 41% at PoderData to 47% at Datafolha.

bancoMaster.text1: ⚖️ ON 25/Sep THE SUPERIOR COUNCIL OF THE FEDERAL PROSECUTION SERVICE FORMED A MAJORITY AGAINST REMOVING PROSECUTOR GENERAL PAULO GONET FROM THE MASTER CASE PROCEEDINGS, as Gazeta do Povo, O Globo, Folha de S.Paulo and Poder360 report, and in O Globo's 17:22 BRT update the vote on that point stood at 7 to 0. On opening an internal inquiry into his conduct, the vote stood at 4 to 3 in favour, with two votes still to be cast, so that point had no result. Gonet's name appears in the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) report with messages extracted from Daniel Vorcaro's phone, and he denies being close to the banker.
bancoMaster.text2: 📅 ON THE SAME DAY, EDSON FACHIN GAVE THE PROSECUTOR GENERAL'S OFFICE FIVE DAYS TO WEIGH IN ON THE PENDING REQUESTS IN THE CASE, among them requests linked to the detentions of Henrique Vorcaro, Felipe Vorcaro, Fabiano Zettel and Daniel Lopes Monteiro, André Mendonça's filing on the report that Alexandre de Moraes used regarding him, and the request by the OAB (Brazilian Bar Association) for confidentiality of lawyers' communications, according to Gazeta do Povo, with the decision also reported by G1 and Estadão. The decision does not settle the requests. 🗣️ And Estadão reports that Flávio Bolsonaro said on 25/Sep that he tried to speak with Daniel Vorcaro in the four days before the banker's arrest, on 17 November 2025, to discuss the film Dark Horse.
bancoMaster.text3: ⚠️ The price on this page for the contract on a Supreme Court justice leaving by impeachment before 2027 comes from the reading confirmed on 25/Sep, 17:08 BRT, and stands at 3.35%, with USD 0.09M cumulative volume, with no move since the reading confirmed on 24/Sep. AFOS does not attribute the price of that contract to the news flow of the case: it measures both side by side, each with its own timestamp. 🏷️ Still on the calendar, not completed acts, are the testimony of Gabriel Galípolo to the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf), expected in October, and that of Daniel Vorcaro, which was set for 24/Sep and was postponed at the request of the defence, according to Gazeta do Povo.
bancoMaster.conclusao: The case moved on 25/Sep through two procedural acts, not decisions on the merits: the Superior Council of the Federal Prosecution Service formed a majority to keep Paulo Gonet on the proceedings and, on opening an internal inquiry into his conduct, stood at 4 to 3 in favour with two votes still to be cast, and Edson Fachin asked the Prosecutor General's Office for an opinion within five days on the pending requests. The request to revoke Daniel Vorcaro's detention has been with Fachin since 18/Sep, undecided.

stf.toffoli: He is the justice with the highest rejection in the AtlasIntel poll in partnership with Estadão released on 23/Sep, a survey separate from the electoral one, with 1,852 adults interviewed between 17 and 21/Sep and a 2.0pp margin. On 24/Sep Folha de S.Paulo reports that he voted to remove an opponent of Davi Alcolumbre from the Amapá election and that André Mendonça interrupted the ruling; the act has a single source and is recorded here as attributed. He remains the target of the impeachment request filed by Renan Santos and of the inquiry committee request by Alessandro Vieira.
stf.moraes: The ruling opened on 15/Sep on whether he should be investigated over his relationship with Daniel Vorcaro still has no date, suspended by a request for further review by Flávio Dino. On 22/Sep he was one of the two justices named in the parliamentary inquiry committee (CPI) request that Cristiano Zanin declined to unlock by injunction, and Luiz Fux was drawn as rapporteur of the case on visits by his wife and by Vorcaro to senators. On 25/Sep André Mendonça's filing on the report he used regarding that justice joined the list of pending requests that Edson Fachin sent to the Prosecutor General's Office, with a five day deadline.
stf.gilmar: ⚖️ ON 24/Sep HE TOOK TO THE FULL BENCH OF THE SUPREME COURT a dispute over power plant court-ordered debts (precatórios) with an estimated impact of R$ 103 billion, after messages from Daniel Vorcaro's phone showed interest in the vote of one justice in that case (O Globo, G1 and Gazeta do Povo). On 25/Sep G1 reports that the AGU (Office of the Attorney General) and he are closing in on the so-called court-ordered debt industry used by Master; the report comes from a single media group and is included here with attribution. On 18/Sep he had publicly admitted a meeting with Vorcaro.
stf.dino: On 15/Sep he asked for further review in the ruling on the investigation into Alexandre de Moraes, which suspends the analysis for up to 90 days, and he had not returned the case by 25/Sep. On 22/Sep he said the right moment for the Supreme Court to examine the case on parliamentary earmarks is after the elections, as G1, O Globo and Gazeta do Povo reported.
stf.mendonca: His 76 page filing, submitted on 21/Sep, asks Edson Fachin for the summary dismissal of the inquiry against him and for consideration of opening an investigation into Alexandre de Moraes for abuse of authority. On 25/Sep it joined the list of pending requests that Fachin sent to the Prosecutor General's Office, with a five day deadline. On 24/Sep his office received Flávio Bolsonaro's request to investigate the relationship between Lula and Daniel Vorcaro, and on 25/Sep Folha de S.Paulo reports that he keeps under seal the Master case proceeding in which he denied an operation against Cláudio Castro; the report has a single source and is included with attribution.
stf.nexo: The link with the election is about the calendar and about institutions, not about the result, and the measurement this panel uses is still the one from 23/Sep. In the AtlasIntel poll in partnership with Bloomberg, an electoral wave of 5,015 participants between 17 and 22/Sep, 52.3% say the crisis at the Supreme Court hurts Lula's candidacy more and 20.8% say it hurts Flávio Bolsonaro's more, with 15.5% seeing equal harm. On which group is more involved in the [Banco Master](/en/glossary#banco-master) scheme, 43.8% point to allies of Jair Bolsonaro and 43.4% point to allies of Lula, a tie within the 1.0pp margin. 🗳️ None of the six national polls of 24/Sep repeated these questions and there was no new national poll on 25/Sep, so the measurement of the link has no new reading.
stf.analise: THE CONTRACT ON A SUPREME COURT JUSTICE LEAVING BY IMPEACHMENT BEFORE 2027 STANDS AT 3.35% (USD 0.09M cumulative volume), reading confirmed on 25/Sep, 17:08 BRT, with no move since the reading confirmed on 24/Sep. It is a thin book, and the price is 22.75pp from the top of the series, 26.10% on 11/Sep, and 1.25pp from the floor, 2.10% on 08/Jun. ⚠️ Perception of the Court, measured in the AtlasIntel poll in partnership with Estadão of 23/Sep, a separate survey of 1,852 adults between 17 and 21/Sep with a 2.0pp margin, stands at 61% who say they do not trust the work and the justices against 27.8% who do. That pollster's series went from 51.3% distrust in August 2025 to 60% in March and 61% now. ⛔ The panel does not link the price of the contract to the acts of the day, by the Federal Prosecution Service Council and by Edson Fachin: it measures both, each with its own timestamp.
stf.fachin: ⚖️ ON 25/Sep HE GAVE THE PROSECUTOR GENERAL'S OFFICE (PGR) FIVE DAYS TO WEIGH IN ON THE PENDING REQUESTS IN THE MASTER CASE AND [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) INVESTIGATIONS, which have been with the presidency of the Supreme Court since 12/Sep, and only after the opinion will he decide on them (Gazeta do Povo, G1 and Estadão). Since 18/Sep he has had on his desk the request to revoke Daniel Vorcaro's pre-trial detention, undecided as of 25/Sep, and on 24/Sep Flávio Bolsonaro's defence asked him to suspend the investigations that reach the senator, as O Globo reports.
